group.ja: 重力と長距離相互作用

summary.ja: PMEの補間をcardinal B-splineへ置き換え、滑らかな近似エネルギーと力を得るSPMEです。補間次数・格子・微分法を固定し、原PMEとの差を説明します。
summary.en: SPME replaces Lagrange interpolation with cardinal B-splines for smooth approximate energies and forces. Specify spline order, mesh and differentiation when comparing with original PME.

references.label: Essmann, U.; Perera, L.; Berkowitz, M. L.; Darden, T.; Lee, H.; Pedersen, L. G. (1995). A smooth particle mesh Ewald method.
references.scope: Neutral-charge Ewald terms and corrections, cardinal B-spline structure factors and smooth energy/force evaluation.

supports.ja: 中性点電荷のEwald項と補正、cardinal B-splineによる構造因子、滑らかなエネルギーと力の評価を確認。
supports.en: Neutral-charge Ewald terms and corrections, cardinal B-spline structure factors and smooth energy/force evaluation.

verification.locator: Sections II–IV, Eqs. (2.1)–(2.5), (4.1)–(4.8), and Appendix A surface-term discussion

references.label: Darden, T.; York, D.; Pedersen, L. (1993). Particle mesh Ewald: An N·log(N) method for Ewald sums in large systems.
references.scope: Original Lagrange PME being modified; distinct from the B-spline formulation specified here.

supports.ja: 置き換えられるLagrange版PMEの原典です。B-splineを用いる本文献の採用形とは区別します。
supports.en: Original Lagrange PME being modified; distinct from the B-spline formulation specified here.

verification.locator: Introduction and Method, printed pp. 10089–10090, Eqs. (2)–(9)

assumptions: The initial validation specification is noncoincident point charges in a cubic, triply periodic Coulomb cell with zero net charge and no uniform neutralizing background.
Omit only i=j in the same cell (n=0); retain periodic self images and account separately for the self-energy correction.
Specify splitting, real cutoff and reciprocal/mesh parameters. The mean-potential gauge and the macroscopic surface convention are different choices.
Approximate structure factors with cardinal B-splines and matching Fourier correction/FFT normalization. Fourth-order (cubic) interpolation is an initial comparison candidate, not implemented code.
units: Comparison convention: fixed length ℓ₀, charge q₀ and Coulomb prefactor kₑ; energy unit kₑq₀²/ℓ₀ and force unit kₑq₀²/ℓ₀². The splitting coefficient has inverse-length units. Do not mix reduced kₑ=1 and SI conventions or reuse gravitational-PM signs.
boundary_conditions: Triply periodic neutral cell; the initial comparison specifies a conducting (tin-foil) exterior with zero macroscopic surface term and separately fixes the mean-potential gauge. Vacuum-exterior, slab and isolated-boundary results are different problems.

next_deliverable.ja: 補間次数・格子・力の評価規約を明記した比較。
next_deliverable.en: A comparison with explicit interpolation order, mesh and force convention.

limitations.ja: 日英の詳細解説・代表式・出典を公開。専用の実装・数値検証結果はまだありません。
limitations.en: Detailed bilingual reading, representative equations and sources are published. No dedicated implementation or numerical verification result is provided yet.

metadata_review.level: method-specific source curation; planned formulation; no dedicated implementation or new numerical verification

assumptions_ja: 最初の検証仕様は、立方体セル内の重なりのない点電荷と3次元周期Coulomb相互作用です。総電荷はゼロとし、一様中和背景は含めません。
同一粒子の同一セル項（i=j, n=0）のみを除外し、自己の周期像との相互作用は残します。自己エネルギー補正を別に扱います。
分割係数・実空間打切り・逆空間または格子条件を明示します。静電ポテンシャルの平均をゼロにする選択と、巨視的な表面項の境界規約は別です。
構造因子をcardinal B-splineで近似し、補間のFourier補正とFFT規格化を揃えます。最初の比較候補は4次（3次多項式）補間ですが、未実装です。
units_ja: 比較仕様：長さℓ₀、電荷q₀、Coulomb係数kₑを固定。エネルギー単位はkₑq₀²/ℓ₀、力はkₑq₀²/ℓ₀²、分割係数は長さの逆数です。kₑ=1の無次元化とSIを混ぜず、周期重力PMの符号・規約を流用しません。
boundary_conditions_ja: 3次元周期・中性セル。最初の比較では外部導体（tin-foil）規約で巨視的表面項をゼロとし、平均ポテンシャルを別途固定します。真空外部・slab・孤立境界の結果とは直接比較しません。

problem.ja: 周期像を含む中性点電荷のCoulombエネルギーと力。孤立重力や電子密度のHartree場とは区別します。
problem.en: Coulomb energy and forces for neutral point charges and periodic images, distinct from isolated gravity or an electron-density Hartree field.

variant.ja: 実装前の比較仕様：Essmannら（1995）のB-spline構造因子と、近似エネルギーの解析微分。原論文の全変種を実装したという意味ではありません。
variant.en: Pre-implementation specification: Essmann et al. (1995) B-spline structure factors and analytic differentiation of the approximate energy, not implementation of every paper variant.

ja: 原PMEとの補間差を明らかにし、滑らかなエネルギー・力を同条件で比較したい場合。
補間次数・格子密度・力の評価法を固定し、直接Ewaldの収束値と比較できる場合。
en: Comparing interpolation choices with original PME while seeking smooth energy and forces.
Checking specified spline order, mesh density and force differentiation against a converged direct-Ewald reference.

ja: 「PME」と呼ぶだけで、B-spline次数・窓の補正・FFT規格化・微分法を省略する場合。
解析的な力を用いれば、有限格子で運動量とエネルギーの双方が厳密保存すると仮定する場合。
孤立・slab・非中性系を、同じ3D中性仕様のまま扱う場合。
en: Leaving spline order, interpolation-window correction, FFT normalization or differentiation unspecified under a generic PME label.
Assuming analytic forces alone guarantee both exact momentum and energy conservation on a finite mesh.
Applying the neutral 3D specification unchanged to isolated, slab or nonneutral systems.
